name: Put' pacifista
source: Semyon is a long-known character, and there's almost nothing he hasn't tried to escape from the 'Sovyonok' camp. Our hero finds himself in the exact same situation, but even after a hundred cycles without finding a way out, he simply continues to live week after week. However, in one of the cycles, events unfold for Semyon that differ from the usual routine. On the very first night, he learns that he is not the only one trapped in the camp, which compels him to start digging for answers to the new questions that arise, all while trying to wrestle with his past.
translation: 谢苗是一个久负盛名的人物，几乎所有的事情他都试图逃离“索维诺克”阵营。我们的英雄发现自己处于完全相同的情况，但即使经过一百个循环而没有找到出路，他只是继续一周又一周地生活。然而，在其中一个周期中，谢苗发生了与平常不同的事件。在第一天晚上，他就得知自己并不是唯一被困在营地里的人，这迫使他开始挖掘出现的新问题的答案，同时试图与自己的过去搏斗。
